title: 4610--Continuous Water Monitoring System
description: The Veterans Integrated Service Network #04 (VISN 04) Contracting Office / Wilmington Veteran Administration Medical Center intends to issue an Invitation for Bid (IFB) to award a single, firm fixed-price contract for services related to the installation of a Continuous Water Monitoring System and Automated Faucets at the Wilmington VAMC, 1601 Kirkwood Highway, Wilmington, DE 19805. All work must be in compliance with applicable codes, VA policy/standards (including VHA Directive 1061), and the terms of this contract. The contractor shall provide all tools, travel, trades, labor, materials, permits, licenses, and supervision for the project as specified in the statement of work. Amendments to the solicitation will also be posted on this website. All parties must obtain solicitation documents and amendments through the website. Hard copies will not be mailed or emailed. It is the responsibility of the Contractor to frequently check the website for all notices, amendments, etc., regarding this solicitation. The Government will not be responsible for any notification not sent or received by the Contractor. The contract will be awarded in accordance with the procedures specified in the solicitation. The solicitation will be issued as an Invitation for Bid (IFB) conducted in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 14. This project is being solicited as a TOTAL 100% SERVICE-DISABLED VETERAN OWNED SMALL BUSINESS SET-ASIDE (SDVOSB). The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code for this procurement is 221310 (Water Supply and Irrigation Systems) as appropriate for the installation scope, with the applicable small business size standard of $41M. The Magnitude of this procurement is $100,000 - $250,000. A pre-bid meeting/site visit will be held with exact location and time details to be contained in the solicitation. All potential offerors are strongly encouraged to attend the pre-bid meeting/site visit. All respondents must be registered in the System Award Management System (SAM) data base at time of bid submittal. Offerors must be verified in the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and Veteran Small Business Certification (VetCert) at https://veterans.certify.sba.gov/ at the time of proposal offering in accordance with Veterans Affairs acquisition requirements. Any offeror not VetCert or SAM verified at time of proposal submittal will be disqualified and proposal will be rejected. All questions pertaining to this solicitation must be received in writing via e-mail to the Contract Specialist at Minnisha.Hearst@va.gov. NO TELEPHONE REQUESTS WILL BE HONORED. All questions and Government responses will be posted to the SAM.gov website.

description: This contract notice announces the call for tenders for PreCommercial Procurement of Research & Development services on the security domain (Security Harmonized Innovation for Enhanced Law enforcement capabilities in Dynamic crowd protection through PreCommercial Procurement). SHIELD PCP is a cross broder joint procurement of Research & Development services to reinforce the field of protection of publics spaces and crowd management. The tobedeveloped solutions are expected to achieve TRL 78. The PCP should deliver successful, innovative and fully tested product(s) and/or service(s), that meet the common needs of the Public Buyer Group (PBG) to procure research services, develop innovative marketable solutions, speed up the timetomarket and provide best value for money. More concretely, the common needs of the public buyers group are as follows. The SHIELD PCP initiative aims to drive innovation by empowering buyers to actively influence the development of costeffective solutions tailored to their unique requirements. The overarching aim is to equip security stakeholders with cuttingedge technology procured through innovative processes, offering solutions that enable seamless coordination and cooperation among all stakeholders, especially law enforcement agencies (LEAs). The SHIELD PCP project adopts a topdown approach. This method consolidates widely agreedupon scenarios to address critical security challenges, providing a detailed identification of innovation needs at both the process and technology levels. This topdown approach enabled the alignment of stakeholders, from security forces to public authorities, ensuring innovative solutions meet shared needs for public space protection. After evaluation of the tenders received, the PCP will be implemented by means of awarding a Framework Agreement where contractors are developing the solution in competition. It includes calloffs for Specific Contracts for Phase 1: Solution Design, Phase 2: Prototype Development and Integration, and Phase 3: Validation in real operational environment. SHIELD PCP has received funding from the Horizon Europe Framework Programme (HORIZON) under grant agreement n°101225962. However, the European Union will not participate as a contracting authority in the procurement.

title: Belgium – Magnetic resonance scanners – Levering, plaatsing, indienststelling, opleiding en onderhoud van een 1,5T High End MRI toestel Met verplicht plaatsbezoek op 14 juli 2026
description: Het gaat hier om de vervanging van een bestaande 3T MRI naar een high end 1,5T MRI. Het ontmantelen en verwijderen van het bestaande toestel maakt deel uit van de opdracht. Het toestel zal hoofdzakelijk worden ingezet voor cardiale en spinale onderzoeken; de aangeboden oplossing dient hierop technisch en functioneel afgestemd te zijn. De aangeboden oplossing garandeert een vlotte scan en levert beelden van hoge kwaliteit dankzij de nieuwste beeldvormingstechnologieën in patiëntvriendelijke omgeving. Bovendien kan de oplossing worden uitgebreid met geavanceerde AI-software, die de beeldkwaliteit verder optimaliseert en de diagnostische nauwkeurigheid ondersteunt. In een eerste fase wordt de bestaande MRI-installatie ontmanteld en afgevoerd. Aansluitend worden de noodzakelijke bouwkundige en technische aanpassingen uitgevoerd, met inbegrip van de realisatie van een nieuwe Faraday-kooi. Deze fase heeft tot doel het lokaal volledig gebruiksklaar te maken voor de plaatsing van het nieuwe MRI-toestel. De levering, installatie en indienststelling van het nieuwe MRI-toestel zijn voorzien vanaf begin 2027. Tijdens deze fase kunnen de werken plaatsvinden zonder operationele MRI-activiteit in het betrokken lokaal.

title: France – Water-purifying apparatus – Acquisition et exploitation de stations mobiles de traitement des PFAS dans l'eau destinée à la consommation humaine
description: Le marché envisagé a pour objet l'acquisition et l'exploitation de stations mobiles de traitement des PFAS dans l'eau destinée à la consommation humaine. Entre 2023 et 2024, l'ARS Grand Est a mené des campagnes d'analyses exploratoires des substances perfluoroalkylées et polyfluoroalkylées (PFAS) dans l'eau destinée à la consommation humaine. Le respect d'une limite de 0,1 µg/l au robinet du consommateur pour la somme de 20 PFAS analysés est exigé depuis janvier 2023. Un contrôle sanitaire a été déployé dès 2025 en Région Grand Est en anticipation de l'obligation de contrôle, à partir de 2026, des PFAS dans l'eau destinée à la consommation humaine. Or, une contamination a été mise en évidence au niveau de plusieurs ressources du Grand Est, entrainant des restrictions de consommation de l'eau pour les habitants. Dans l'attente d'une solution pérenne, les collectivités concernées fournissent de l'eau en bouteille à la population, ce qui représente une dépense importante pour les communes rurales. Dans ce contexte, la Région Grand Est souhaite acquérir des stations mobiles de traitement afin de soutenir les collectivités confrontées à cette situation, le temps d'identifier une solution pérenne à la pollution. Dans le cadre de ce marché, un comité de pilotage, composé de la Région Grand Est, l'Agence régionale de santé et les Agences de l'eau concernées, identifiera les communes dans lesquelles les stations pourront être déployées. Ainsi, le marché objet de la consultation vise ; - la fourniture de stations mobiles de traitement des PFAS dans l'eau destinée à la consommation humaine ; - la mise en service et l'exploitation (suivi de traitement, rechargement matériaux filtrants etc…) des stations mobiles de traitement sur plusieurs sites de la Région Grand Est. Le marché sera conclu sous la forme d'un accord-cadre mono-attributaire à bons de commandes, sans montant minimum et pour un montant maximum de 2 430 000 euro(s) HT sur la durée totale du marché
